Food.label: Τρόφιμα (ένα στοιχείο ανά γραμμή)
Food.help: Items that tame/feed this pet, e.g. bone.

LeashItem.label: Leash Item
LeashItem.help: Item used to tame, e.g. lead.

LeashRequirements.label: Leash Requirements
LeashRequirements.help: Flags like Tamed, Baby, Owner — one per line.

GrowUpItem.label: Grow-Up Item
GrowUpItem.help: Item that ages a baby up (baby-capable pets).

RetainEquipmentOnTame.label: Retain Equipment On Tame
RetainEquipmentOnTame.help: Keeps the armor and weapons a wild mob was wearing when it is tamed, as real pet equipment that drops on death and release. Off strips the gear and drops it where the mob stood. Equipment-capable pet types only.

AllowMetamorphosis.label: Allow Metamorphosis
AllowMetamorphosis.help: Lets a Tadpole pet mature into a Frog pet after vanilla's 20-minute timer. The pet keeps its name, level, XP and skill state, but permanently becomes a Frog — including losing Tadpole-only skilltrees. Off (the default) freezes the timer so the pet stays a Tadpole.

Brain_Disabled.label: Disabled Brain AI (one per line)
Brain_Disabled.help: Vanilla brain AI to switch off, e.g. activity:fight or behavior:SonicBoom. Clearing this restores vanilla AI — for Piglin Brutes, Piglins, Hoglins and Zoglins that means the pet will attack its owner. Takes effect the next time the pet spawns.

TeleportDistance.label: Teleport Distance
TeleportDistance.help: How many blocks this pet type can fall behind its owner before it teleports to them. The plugin default is 32.

EnabledWildAttackers.label: Enabled Wild Attackers (one per line)
EnabledWildAttackers.help: Vanilla mobs allowed to pick this pet type as a target on their own, by mob id (iron_golem, wolf, warden). Empty (the default) means no wild mob hunts this pet unprovoked; add * to allow every mob. A mob the pet hits, or a golem defending a villager the pet hurt, still fights back regardless.

CanExplode.label: Can Explode
CanExplode.help: Lets a Sulfur Cube pet that has absorbed TNT detonate when ignited. Off (the default) cancels the explosion and clears the fuse, so a cube fed TNT cannot blow up next to its owner.

AllowShearing.label: Allow Shearing
AllowShearing.help: Lets players use shears on a Sulfur Cube pet to pop out its absorbed block. Vanilla shearing also kills the cube, so this is off by default — otherwise any passer-by could one-click somebody's pet to death.

Skill_Backpack_OpenInWater.label: Backpack: Open In Water
Skill_Backpack_OpenInWater.help: Lets the owner open this pet's backpack while the pet is standing in water or lava. On by default for pets that swim — fish, squids, guardians, dolphins, axolotls, drowned, frogs, turtles — since blocking it in water blocks it everywhere they live. Off for land pets, whose owners get the "is swimming" refusal as before.

CurseNearbyPlayers.label: Curse Nearby Players
CurseNearbyPlayers.help: Lets an Elder Guardian pet keep vanilla's curse pulse: every minute it gives Mining Fatigue II for 5 minutes, plus the jumpscare and sound, to every survival player within 50 blocks — not just its owner. Off by default, since a pet parked in a base would otherwise grind everyone's mining to a halt.

petTypes.animationsNote: MyPet plays each of these by its default name (the label). Override one only if your model names it differently; leave blank to use the default. Walk/idle/run/jump are handled by the model plugin and are not configured here.
